info.title: Latchkey administration API
info.description: Every route uses the existing operator session, short-lived grant, enrolled-device signature, tenant checks, cryptographic envelope validation and live mutation fence. Plaintext values and vault keys are never accepted by the server. See README for exact wire signing and capability limits.

operatorSession.name: Cookie
operatorSession.description: Existing admitted operator session; obtained through the native authentication flow.

grant.name: x-latchkey-grant
grant.description: Short-lived OPAQUE-admitted grant, bound to operator session, device and generation.

deviceSignature.name: x-latchkey-signature
deviceSignature.description: Existing enrolled P-256 device signature over signingText(method,fullPathIncludingQuery,grant,nonce,time,digest(rawBody)). GET rawBody is empty bytes.
